name: TRIPPEDD Studio Capability Graph
principle: Expand capability, not dependency count. Every tool must own a production job, an interchange contract, or a measurable recovery/quality function.

promotionPolicy.research: document capability, license, maintenance, integration boundary
promotionPolicy.probe: install or resolve executable/library and run a real-input smoke test
promotionPolicy.production: wire into a pipeline stage with measured outputs, provenance, and recovery
promotionPolicy.rejection: do not add a dependency when it duplicates an existing capability or creates more operational cost than it removes
